capabilities.name: Device identification (lockdown/sysfs)
capabilities.description: Identify attached device: model, chip, iOS, state via sysfs USB + lockdown enrichment.
limitations: chip from serial is heuristic when no lockdown

capabilities.name: Logical + backup acquisition (AFU, paired)
capabilities.description: idevicebackup2/pymobiledevice3 backup + AFC media pull on an unlocked, paired device.
limitations: keychain needs encrypted backup + password

capabilities.name: Backup parsing (Manifest.db + artifacts)
capabilities.description: Parse an acquired backup into normalized artifacts.

capabilities.name: checkm8 bootrom pwn (A7-A11, DFU)
capabilities.description: gaster/ipwndfu pwn of DFU bootrom; success verified by PWND marker in USB serial.
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
A10/A11 on iOS 16+ require passcode-off/erase (destructive caveat)

capabilities.name: usbliter8 PWND verification (A12/A13)
capabilities.description: Host-side verification of a usbliter8-pwned device. The exploit itself runs on the RP2350 rig; CoreProbe only confirms the resulting PWND marker.
limitations: exploit requires dedicated hardware (RP2350 board)

capabilities.name: Jailbreak route detection (AFU, app-based)
capabilities.description: DETECTION ONLY: verifies whether an installed jailbreak/agent exposes AFC2 root. CoreProbe does not execute any jailbreak (Dopamine/Serotonin/etc. must be installed by the examiner).
limitations: CoreProbe cannot install or run jailbreaks itself

capabilities.name: palera1n jailbreak boot (A8-A11, checkm8)
capabilities.description: Real palera1n run: enters recovery from a booted state when needed, then boots the rootless jailbreak. Success is claimed only when an objective state change is observed (AFC2 mountable or PongoOS reachable).
prerequisites: DFU/recovery mode, or booted + paired for recovery entry
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
A11 on iOS 16+ requires the passcode to be disabled (upstream palera1n constraint)

capabilities.name: checkra1n jailbreak (A7-A11, legacy)
capabilities.description: checkra1n CLI run (checkm8) from DFU/recovery. Success is claimed only on AFC2 mountable or a PWND marker in the USB serial.
prerequisites: device in DFU or recovery mode
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
legacy tool: upstream checkra1n targets the iOS 12-14.x era; not maintained for modern iOS

capabilities.name: TrollStore install / verify (CoreTrust, AFU)
capabilities.description: Installs an examiner-provided TrollStore .tipa via pymobiledevice3 developer services, or verifies an existing TrollStore install via the app list. Permanent signing happens on-device via the CoreTrust bug.
prerequisites: examiner-provided .tipa/.ipa payload, or TrollStore already installed
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
host installs/verifies only; not an extraction route itself

capabilities.name: AFU agent install + AFC2 verify (app-based jailbreaks)
capabilities.description: Generic AFU agent flow: installs an examiner-provided jailbreak/agent .ipa/.tipa via developer services, then verifies AFC2 root. Never claims the jailbreak itself ran on-device.
prerequisites: examiner-provided agent .ipa/.tipa in a payload directory
limitations: executor exists but no test fixture exercises exec_afu_agent directly (only planner strategy presence is asserted) - held at DOCUMENTED until a fixture lands
success requires AFC2 live after the examiner opens the agent app on-device once

capabilities.name: PongoOS ramdisk boot (checkm8, DFU/recovery)
capabilities.description: Boots the PongoOS shell via palera1n -p as the ramdisk-chain stepping stone. Success is claimed only when irecovery answers (PongoOS reachable).
prerequisites: checkm8 chip (A8-A11) in DFU/recovery or PWND state
limitations: executor exists but no test fixture exercises exec_pongo_ramdisk directly (only planner strategy presence is asserted) - held at DOCUMENTED until a fixture lands
no recorded hardware validation run yet

capabilities.name: usbliter8 chain boot (A12/A13, after RP2350 PWND)
capabilities.description: Post-PWND chain: with the PWND:[usbliter8] marker present, runs usbliter8ctl demote + boot. Success is claimed only when PongoOS or recovery/iBoot is reachable afterwards.
prerequisites: PWND:[usbliter8] marker present (RP2350 rig already ran the bootrom exploit)
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
CoreProbe does not run the bootrom exploit itself - the RP2350 rig does; this adapter only continues the chain after PWND

capabilities.name: Misaka/Nugget MobileGestalt tool install (iOS 26.0-26.1)
capabilities.description: Host-side eligibility check + install of the Misaka/Nugget MobileGestalt tool (.tipa) via developer services, or verification that it is already installed. The exploit itself runs on-device when the examiner opens the app.
prerequisites: examiner-provided .tipa payload, or tool already installed
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
userspace MobileGestalt tweaks only - not a filesystem acquisition route

capabilities.name: Restore-traversal research probe (CVE-2026-84598)
capabilities.description: Crafted restore-manifest probe: observes whether a <26.7 target's restore stack accepts traversal paths. Research-safe by design - the harness aborts before any file transfer.
limitations: no recorded hardware validation run yet (validation required)
research probe only: a positive result is schema acceptance, not acquisition; the Find My gate may block completion
